title: Enova director appointment and land matters
subtitle: Closed-session land acquisition, Ontario Land Tribunal settlement authority, and a deferred renoviction legislation notice of motion.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on August 12, 2024. It appointed Don McKinnon as a director of Enova Energy Corporation until the 2025 annual shareholders' meeting {{vote:m1}}. Enova is the City's energy company, so this keeps its board filled.

After a recess, council met in closed session and then reported two actions. It authorized the Chief Administrative Officer, or a designate, to negotiate and approve acquiring a property, with documents to satisfy the City Solicitor {{vote:m3}}. It also authorized staff to enter settlement negotiations on an Ontario Land Tribunal case, with the Director of Development and Housing Approvals able to approve a settlement within earlier direction {{vote:m4}}.

A notice of motion on renoviction legislation was deferred. It had been brought forward in June and needs more time to confirm the preferred direction. It is expected at the August 26, 2024 council meeting. The meeting adjourned at 7:06 p.m.

decisions.detail: Don McKinnon was appointed a director of Enova Energy Corporation until the 2025 annual shareholders' meeting.
The Chief Administrative Officer or a designate may negotiate and approve acquiring the property discussed in closed session and sign the documents, to the City Solicitor's satisfaction.
Staff may enter settlement negotiations on an Ontario Land Tribunal case, and the Director of Development and Housing Approvals may approve a settlement in line with earlier closed-session direction.
